description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Thudella, Ja- Ela D/S Division,Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.512200 (24/0156)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters, specifically the declaration of determinations by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels in various locations. It contains detailed land parcel numbers, cadastral map references, ownership details, and legal determinations under the Registration of Title Act - all characteristics of Land Gazettes (Type 4).
